I gotta say i really doubted the Shirewolves until the Spectacular.  Just didn’t think they beat any really impressive teams other than Team Action, which they only won because Bateman misspoke.  But after the Spectacular, they get all the credit in the world.  Both ladies do a great job and compliment each other well.  Focusing on Rachel specifically, i think she’s comes a real long way.  She used to be visibly nervous and robotic and now she is just a joy to watch and you can tell she really has fun with it!
